primary.description: A clear chicken soup with carrots, celery and fine noodles, made by simmering a whole chicken for 40 minutes.
primary.keywords: huhnersuppe mit nudeln, german chicken noodle soup, clear chicken soup with noodles, chicken soup german style, huehnersuppe recipe

recipeInstructions.name: Step 1
recipeInstructions.text: Put the chicken in a large pot with the water and bring slowly to a bare simmer. Skim the foam.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 2
recipeInstructions.text: Add the 2 whole carrots, celery, leek, onion and bay and simmer for 40 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 3
recipeInstructions.text: Lift out the chicken and strain the broth. Shred the meat and discard the skin and bones.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 4
recipeInstructions.text: Return the broth to the pot with the diced carrot and simmer for 5 minutes. Add the noodles and cook for 5 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 5
recipeInstructions.text: Add the meat, parsley, nutmeg and salt and serve.

primary.description: Bone-in chicken thighs seasoned and pressure cooked in 10 minutes, then crisped under the grill. Four servings in 35 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 1
recipeInstructions.text: Rub the thighs with the salt, paprika, garlic powder and pepper. Set the pot to sauté, heat the oil and brown the thighs skin side down in two batches, 5 minutes each. Lift out.

primary.name: Ham and Cheese Sliders
primary.description: A tray of soft sweet rolls filled with ham and Swiss cheese, brushed with mustard, poppy seed and Worcestershire butter and baked until golden. Twelve sliders.
primary.keywords: ham and cheese sliders, baked ham and cheese sliders, ham and swiss sliders, ham and cheese sliders on sweet rolls, party ham sliders
recipeIngredient: 12 soft sweet dinner rolls, joined in a sheet (about 500 g)
200 g sliced Swiss cheese, Emmental or Gruyère

recipeInstructions.name: Step 1
recipeInstructions.text: Heat the oven to 180°C / 350°F (160°C / 320°F fan) and grease a 23 x 33 cm baking dish.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 2
recipeInstructions.text: Without separating the rolls, slice the whole sheet in half horizontally with a serrated knife. Set the bottom half in the dish and spread it with 1 tbsp of the mustard.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 3
recipeInstructions.text: Layer the ham and then the cheese over the bottom half and put the top half of the rolls back on.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 4
recipeInstructions.text: Whisk the melted butter with the remaining mustard, the Worcestershire sauce, sugar, poppy seeds, onion granules and garlic granules. Spoon it over the tops of the rolls and brush it into an even layer.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 5
recipeInstructions.text: Cover with foil and bake for 15 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for 10 minutes more, until the tops are golden and the cheese has melted.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 6
recipeInstructions.text: Rest for 5 minutes, then cut into 12 sliders along the lines of the rolls and serve warm.

primary.description: A beef brisket joint cooked under pressure with onions, garlic and stock for 90 minutes until tender enough to slice or shred.
primary.keywords: instant pot beef brisket, pressure cooker brisket, braised beef brisket, tender beef brisket, brisket with onions

recipeInstructions.name: Step 1
recipeInstructions.text: Mix the paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper and rub all over the brisket. Cut the meat in half if it does not fit the pot.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 2
recipeInstructions.text: Set the Instant Pot to sauté. Heat the olive oil and sear the brisket for 4 minutes on each side. Remove it.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 3
recipeInstructions.text: Layer the onions and garlic in the pot. Add the stock, Worcestershire sauce and tomato purée and stir, scraping the base.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 4
recipeInstructions.text: Return the brisket fat side up. Seal and cook on high pressure for 90 minutes. Release naturally for 20 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 5
recipeInstructions.text: Rest the meat for 15 minutes in the liquid. Skim the fat, reduce the sauce on sauté for 10 minutes, slice the brisket against the grain and serve.

primary.description: A tray bake of buttery sponge topped with rhubarb and a soft meringue, baked for 45 minutes and cut in squares.
primary.keywords: rhabarberkuchen, german rhubarb cake, rhubarb cake with meringue, rhubarb tray bake, rhabarberkuchen recipe
recipeIngredient: 100 g caster sugar, for the meringue

recipeInstructions.name: Step 1
recipeInstructions.text: Heat the oven to 170C and line a 24 x 30 cm tin. Toss the rhubarb with 1 tablespoon of the caster sugar.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 2
recipeInstructions.text: Beat the butter and 200 g sugar until pale. Beat in the 4 yolks and the vanilla, then fold in the flour and baking powder.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 3
recipeInstructions.text: Spread in the tin and press the rhubarb on top. Bake for 25 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 4
recipeInstructions.text: Whisk the whites to stiff peaks, whisk in the 100 g sugar a spoonful at a time and spread over the cake.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 5
recipeInstructions.text: Bake for 20 minutes more until pale gold. Cool in the tin and dust with the icing sugar.

primary.description: Creamy risotto with asparagus tips stirred in at the end and a stock made from the trimmed stalks, ready in 40 minutes.
primary.keywords: risotto agli asparagi, asparagus risotto, italian asparagus risotto, risotto with parmesan and asparagus, spring risotto recipe

recipeInstructions.name: Step 1
recipeInstructions.text: Cut off the asparagus tips 4 cm from the top. Chop the stalks small. Simmer the tough ends in the water with the salt for 15 minutes, then strain and keep hot.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 2
recipeInstructions.text: Melt half the butter in a wide pan and soften the onion for 5 minutes. Add the rice and stir for 2 minutes. Add the wine and stir until absorbed.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 3
recipeInstructions.text: Add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 18 minutes, adding the chopped stalks after 8 minutes and the tips for the last 4 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 4
recipeInstructions.text: Off the heat, beat in the remaining butter and the Parmesan. Cover and rest for 2 minutes.

primary.description: Dark rum shaken with pineapple juice, orange juice and sweet coconut cream, served over crushed ice with fresh nutmeg on top. The tropical drink of the British Virgin Islands.
primary.keywords: painkiller, painkiller cocktail, pusser's painkiller, rum pineapple coconut cocktail, how to make a painkiller
recipeIngredient: 1 orange wedge and 1 pineapple leaf, to garnish

recipeInstructions.name: Step 1
recipeInstructions.text: Put the rum, pineapple juice, orange juice and coconut cream in a cocktail shaker with a handful of ice and shake hard for 15 seconds, until the outside is frosted and the drink is frothy.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 2
recipeInstructions.text: Strain into a tall glass filled with crushed ice.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 3
recipeInstructions.text: Grate fresh nutmeg generously over the top.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 4
recipeInstructions.text: Garnish with the orange wedge and pineapple leaf and serve with a straw.

image.name: Hühnersuppe mit Nudeln recipe
image.creditText: Anhelina Vasylyk, Pexels License via Pexels

primary.description: A clear chicken soup with carrots, celery and fine noodles, made by simmering a whole chicken for 40 minutes.
primary.keywords: huhnersuppe mit nudeln, german chicken noodle soup, clear chicken soup with noodles, chicken soup german style, huehnersuppe recipe

recipeInstructions.name: Step 1
recipeInstructions.text: Put the chicken in a large pot with the water and bring slowly to a bare simmer. Skim the foam.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 2
recipeInstructions.text: Add the 2 whole carrots, celery, leek, onion and bay and simmer for 40 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 3
recipeInstructions.text: Lift out the chicken and strain the broth. Shred the meat and discard the skin and bones.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 4
recipeInstructions.text: Return the broth to the pot with the diced carrot and simmer for 5 minutes. Add the noodles and cook for 5 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 5
recipeInstructions.text: Add the meat, parsley, nutmeg and salt and serve.

primary.description: Light waffles rolled in cinnamon sugar while hot and served with a pot of warm chocolate sauce.

recipeIngredient: 60 g butter, melted, for the batter

recipeInstructions.name: Step 1
recipeInstructions.text: Heat and grease the waffle iron. Whisk the flour, baking powder, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and salt.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 2
recipeInstructions.text: Whisk the eggs, milk and 60 g melted butter into the flour until just combined.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 3
recipeInstructions.text: Cook 4 waffles for 4 minutes each until deep gold.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 4
recipeInstructions.text: Mix the coating sugar and cinnamon on a plate. Brush each hot waffle with the 30 g butter and roll it in the sugar.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 5
recipeInstructions.text: Warm the chocolate sauce for 1 minute and serve beside the waffles for dipping.

primary.name: Instant Pot Chicken Thighs

image.name: Instant Pot Chicken Thighs recipe
image.creditText: ArtHouse Studio, Pexels License via Pexels

primary.description: Bone-in chicken thighs seasoned and pressure cooked in 10 minutes, then crisped under the grill. Four servings in 35 minutes.
primary.keywords: instant pot chicken thighs, pressure cooker chicken thighs, bone in chicken thighs instant pot, easy chicken thighs, juicy chicken thighs

recipeInstructions.name: Step 1
recipeInstructions.text: Rub the thighs with the salt, paprika, garlic powder and pepper. Set the pot to sauté, heat the oil and brown the thighs skin side down in two batches, 5 minutes each. Lift out.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 2
recipeInstructions.text: Pour in the stock and scrape the base. Set the rack in the pot and the thighs on top.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 3
recipeInstructions.text: Lock the pressure cooker lid and pressure cook on high for 10 minutes. Let the pressure release naturally for 5 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 4
recipeInstructions.text: Heat the grill to high. Lay the thighs skin side up on a tray and grill for 5 minutes until crisp. Spoon over the juices.

primary.description: Buttery almond shortbread cookies shaped like long, crooked fingers, with an almond for a fingernail and a smear of jam for gore.
primary.keywords: witch finger cookies, witch fingers halloween cookies, witch finger cookies recipe, almond shortbread finger cookies, halloween finger cookies

recipeInstructions.name: Step 1
recipeInstructions.text: Beat the butter and icing sugar until pale. Beat in the egg, vanilla and almond extract.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 2
recipeInstructions.text: Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt to a soft dough. Cover and chill for 15 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 3
recipeInstructions.text: Heat the oven to 180°C / 355°F. Roll tablespoons of dough into fingers 8 cm long. Pinch two knuckles in each, score lines with a knife and press an almond into the tip.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 4
recipeInstructions.text: Bake on lined trays for 15 minutes until pale gold. Cool, then lift each almond and dab a little jam underneath before pressing back.

recipeIngredient: 60 g dried vermicelli, broken into short pieces

recipeInstructions.name: Step 1

primary.name: Ham and Cheese Sliders
primary.description: A tray of soft sweet rolls filled with ham and Swiss cheese, brushed with mustard, poppy seed and Worcestershire butter and baked until golden. Twelve sliders.
primary.keywords: ham and cheese sliders, baked ham and cheese sliders, ham and swiss sliders, ham and cheese sliders on sweet rolls, party ham sliders
recipeIngredient: 12 soft sweet dinner rolls, joined in a sheet (about 500 g)
200 g sliced Swiss cheese, Emmental or Gruyère

recipeInstructions.name: Step 1
recipeInstructions.text: Heat the oven to 180°C / 350°F (160°C / 320°F fan) and grease a 23 x 33 cm baking dish.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 2
recipeInstructions.text: Without separating the rolls, slice the whole sheet in half horizontally with a serrated knife. Set the bottom half in the dish and spread it with 1 tbsp of the mustard.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 3
recipeInstructions.text: Layer the ham and then the cheese over the bottom half and put the top half of the rolls back on.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 4
recipeInstructions.text: Whisk the melted butter with the remaining mustard, the Worcestershire sauce, sugar, poppy seeds, onion granules and garlic granules. Spoon it over the tops of the rolls and brush it into an even layer.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 5
recipeInstructions.text: Cover with foil and bake for 15 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for 10 minutes more, until the tops are golden and the cheese has melted.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 6
recipeInstructions.text: Rest for 5 minutes, then cut into 12 sliders along the lines of the rolls and serve warm.

image.creditText: Bezalens JGP, Pexels License via Pexels

primary.description: A beef brisket joint cooked under pressure with onions, garlic and stock for 90 minutes until tender enough to slice or shred.
primary.keywords: instant pot beef brisket, pressure cooker brisket, braised beef brisket, tender beef brisket, brisket with onions

recipeInstructions.name: Step 1
recipeInstructions.text: Mix the paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper and rub all over the brisket. Cut the meat in half if it does not fit the pot.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 2
recipeInstructions.text: Set the Instant Pot to sauté. Heat the olive oil and sear the brisket for 4 minutes on each side. Remove it.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 3
recipeInstructions.text: Layer the onions and garlic in the pot. Add the stock, Worcestershire sauce and tomato purée and stir, scraping the base.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 4
recipeInstructions.text: Return the brisket fat side up. Seal and cook on high pressure for 90 minutes. Release naturally for 20 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 5
recipeInstructions.text: Rest the meat for 15 minutes in the liquid. Skim the fat, reduce the sauce on sauté for 10 minutes, slice the brisket against the grain and serve.

recipeIngredient: 60 ml vegetable oil, for shallow frying

recipeInstructions.name: Step 1
recipeInstructions.text: Stir the mayonnaise, mustard, lemon juice, hot sauce and pickles into a remoulade.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 2
recipeInstructions.text: Toss the prawns in the buttermilk, then the flour, then the cornmeal mixed with the Cajun seasoning.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 3
recipeInstructions.text: Heat the oil in a wide frying pan until a crumb sizzles at once and fry the prawns in batches for 2 minutes a side until deep gold. Drain on kitchen paper.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 4
recipeInstructions.text: Split and lightly toast the rolls, spread with the remoulade and fill with the lettuce, tomato and prawns. Serve at once.

image.name: Rhabarberkuchen recipe
image.creditText: m_krohn, Pixabay Content License via Pixabay

primary.description: A tray bake of buttery sponge topped with rhubarb and a soft meringue, baked for 45 minutes and cut in squares.
primary.keywords: rhabarberkuchen, german rhubarb cake, rhubarb cake with meringue, rhubarb tray bake, rhabarberkuchen recipe
recipeIngredient: 100 g caster sugar, for the meringue

recipeInstructions.name: Step 1
recipeInstructions.text: Heat the oven to 170C and line a 24 x 30 cm tin. Toss the rhubarb with 1 tablespoon of the caster sugar.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 2
recipeInstructions.text: Beat the butter and 200 g sugar until pale. Beat in the 4 yolks and the vanilla, then fold in the flour and baking powder.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 3
recipeInstructions.text: Spread in the tin and press the rhubarb on top. Bake for 25 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 4
recipeInstructions.text: Whisk the whites to stiff peaks, whisk in the 100 g sugar a spoonful at a time and spread over the cake.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 5
recipeInstructions.text: Bake for 20 minutes more until pale gold. Cool in the tin and dust with the icing sugar.

image.creditText: Vegan Feast Catering, CC BY 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons

primary.description: Creamy risotto with asparagus tips stirred in at the end and a stock made from the trimmed stalks, ready in 40 minutes.
primary.keywords: risotto agli asparagi, asparagus risotto, italian asparagus risotto, risotto with parmesan and asparagus, spring risotto recipe

recipeInstructions.name: Step 1
recipeInstructions.text: Cut off the asparagus tips 4 cm from the top. Chop the stalks small. Simmer the tough ends in the water with the salt for 15 minutes, then strain and keep hot.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 2
recipeInstructions.text: Melt half the butter in a wide pan and soften the onion for 5 minutes. Add the rice and stir for 2 minutes. Add the wine and stir until absorbed.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 3
recipeInstructions.text: Add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 18 minutes, adding the chopped stalks after 8 minutes and the tips for the last 4 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Step 4
recipeInstructions.text: Off the heat, beat in the remaining butter and the Parmesan. Cover and rest for 2 minutes.
